reference.call: repeated(complete_rows(g1, g2, g3, g4), comps = "control", control = 1, test = "dunnett")

checked.code:
{
    m <- complete_rows(g1, g2, g3, g4)
    n <- nrow(m)
    k <- ncol(m)
    d <- data.frame(value = as.vector(t(m)), treat = factor(rep(seq_len(k), n)), 
        subj = factor(rep(seq_len(n), each = k)))
    set.seed(1)
    s <- summary(multcomp::glht(aov(value ~ subj + treat, d), linfct = multcomp::mcp(treat = "Dunnett")), 
        test = multcomp::adjusted("single-step", maxpts = 1e+06, abseps = 1e-09))
    close(p_of(expected), s$test$pvalues, 1e-04)
}

note: Against a control, Dunnett's test: three comparisons with a shared control.
